notes.title: The main features for this patch are

items.text: new Blacksmithing interface in the inventory (requires the blacksmithing skill)
various bugfixes related to Blacksmithing
controller quick casting for potions
controller quick casting input tooltips to the HUD
The button to access the Blacksmithing interface from the inventory is a small anvil located beneath the inventory grid.
The button is disabled, unless the blacksmithing skill has been learned by the character.
Controller quick casting for potions is done by holding down d-pad left,
which will then blend in the quick casting tooltips to show the specific button combinations for each potion slot.
Quick casting a potion this way will both attempt to consume a potion in the slot AND set the slot as the active slot.
Besides these main features, the patch also includes a variety of other fixes and changes.
These will be listed in the patch notes below.
If certain changes do not affect all platforms, the affected platforms are listed infront of the change.
and we hope you enjoy the update.
Have a great summer!
ADDED the ability to open and use the Blackmisthing interface, if the character has learned the skill.
Fixed various item bonus stats not being correctly displayed in the Blacksmithing interface.
Fixed issues of tooltips not showing in the Blacksmithing interface.
Fixed an issue where a tooltip would display Blacksmithing forge slots with the design of the original Sacred 2.
Added equip feedback to blacksmith forge slots based on the maximum forgable item level, and wether an item can be forged into a slot or not.
ADDED controller quick casting for potions by holding left d-pad.
ADDED input prompts for all controller quick casting, that are being shown when holding down a quick cast modifier.
Fixed an issue where quick casting with a slot that uses LB could permanently open the mini-map instead.
Fixed an issue where quick casting sometimes would not register LB as an input, if the button was held too long.
ADDED the ability to pick up and manually move/ sort items in the stash chest by holding the transfer button.
Fixed an issue where transfering items to the stash chest would temporarily drop items to the ground, resulting in a performance issue when transfering large stacks of potions.
Fixed and issue with item tooltip sizes.
Fixed the campaign status percentage in the character selection menu not showing the correct values.
Fixed navigation issues inside the combat arts menu, that could occurr if certain combat arts were not learned yet.
Fixed an issue with the Runemaster where navigation focus could sometimes jump to the "buy" button unexpectedly.
Fixed an issue with the localizations for skill level tooltips.
Fixed the discoloration of shield HP bars.
Added fur for various animals (Panther, Boar, Spider, Bear, Lion, Troll, Monkey, Rat, Deer, Rabbit, Dog, Cat, Sheep, Werewolf, Gripphon, Minotaur, Horse).
Fixed rendering issues related to fur.
\[Ps5 & XBOX only] Fixed an issue where fur was visible through fog.
Improved Shader of the Dryades Ancient Bark Spell.
Improved Shader of the High Elfs Incandescent Skin Spell.
Fixed several issues with the Seraphim Mystique Armorset Wings FX.
\[Ps5 only] Fixed an issue where the Temple Guardian would become invisible when using Untouchable Force.
Improved rendering logic for Resource loading, Texture management and Terrain patch handling.
Improved Shaders for Tree rendering and lighting interactions.
Fixed an issue with particle emitters.
Fixed a rendering issue with footsteps.
Fixed an issue where the player character can become immortal after interacting with quest dialogues.
Fixed an issue where the controls for "rotate left" and "rotate right" would not move the world map left and right, causing usability issues when using original Sacred 2 character controls.
Fixed an issue where some health potions could not be used with the healing button.
Fixed an issue where the order in which potions would be used by the healing button was inverted.
Fixed an issue where opening the ingame menu while givin movement input could cause permanent movement input being given.
Fixed an issue where the Seraphims Battle Stance would produce a clicking sound if it was active while playing with a controller.
Fixed an issue where the Inquisitors Clustering Maelstrom and Raving Thrust, and the Shadow Warriors Scything Sweep spells could damage and kill Mounts and Followers.
Fixed an issue where the Inquisitors Inexorable Subjugation spell would freeze the caster.
Fixed an issue where interacting with an NPC could cast a spell.
Fixed a crash that would occur when fighting the swamp dragon.
\[PC only] Manually added hardware detection for AMD RDNA 4 GPUs to resolve issues where the GPU was not identified on game start.
Fixed an issue where the savegame could be loaded in the wrong difficulty setting.
\[Ps5 & XBOX only] Fixed an issue where graphics settings were changed when leaving the options menu.
ADDED the requirement to APPLY changes to settings after using the RESET settings option.
\[Ps5 only] Fixed sorting issues with savegames.
\[Ps5 only] Fixed an issue with "ghost" savegames taking up slots and reduce the number of available savegames
returning many of the inventory and equipment slots that were present in the original game,
adding quick casting combat arts and hot-switching weapons to specific slots to controllers,
and improved UI readability for the Steamdeck (only active when played on a handheld device).
As usual, a more detailed changelog will follow below.

notes.title: As the main feature for this update, we are adding the Free Play game mode.

items.text: How does the game mode work?
the main quest progression is disabled completely
side quest progress is reset every time you restart the game, allowing you to repeat quests over and over again to farm items and experience
most main quest BOSSES spawn without the quest requirements allowing you to kill them over and over again to farm items and experience
How do i play the gamemode?
to play the game mode, make sure that you select "Free Play" during the save game selection
you will be able to switch back and forth between campaign and Free Play freely
after switching back to the campaign mode, all previous quest progress made during the campaign mode is restored
Free Play can not be selected during character creation, so you will need to create a character first, and then switch to the Free Play game mode
Free Play will be accessible for both single player, and multi player depending on the game mode the host selected
Additionally, the patch also addresses some crashes and makes some quality of life improvements.
We will share the full changelog below this announcement so you can take a look at the details.
Thank you all for your continued reports, patience, and support — it genuinely helps us keep improving the game. We hope you enjoy exploring Free Play and the improvements coming with Patch 3!

items.text: Dear Heroes of Ancaria!

We are happy to announce that we just released a significant patch for all platforms, addressing most of the stability issues and crashes that occurred since the release. It unfortunately took us a bit longer than expected to provide this update, since most of the stability issues were caused by memory leaks, hidden deep in the 20 year old, T-Energy infected legacy code - truly our greatest foe throughout the entire development.

We also want to take this opportunity to apologize for the bumpy start and hope that with this new patch you are able to enjoy the remaster without any bigger interruptions. Thank you so much for reporting bugs and providing feedback throughout all the different channels!
Alongside implementing the stability fixes, we’ve also tried to include additional updates to gameplay, usability and the general experience where we could.
We hope you enjoy this update!
See you in Ancaria!

items.text: reverted a fix to crashes in the UI when Tabbing through inventory filters: As the fix caused an issue, where hovering over an item in the inventory: would cause movement input to get locked when closing the inventory.: We hope you continue to enjoy Sacred 2 Remaster over the weekend and that this Steam patch further improves your gaming experience.: Remember to continue to report any issues you run into here - Bug Reporter: The Sacred 2 Remaster Team
Dear Sacred 2 Community!
The dev team is working hard to fix the problems with the game and further improve the experience.
We are happy to deliver the first Hotfix patch for Steam today, which addesses the following issues:
fixed two crashes related to UI Elements
fixed some crashes related to the trader & item name generator
fixed a crash where the disabled “Load Latest Savegame” could be clicked when there were no existing savegames
potential fix for the game crashing if a video cannot be played
fixed a crash when leaving the menu with a controller
fixed an issue with cut off strings in item tooltips
increased the World Map zoom speed from 4 to 12
Please note that this is only the first patch. We have implemented further improvements and are currently working on more, but these will need to be thoroughly tested next week. These include:
added VSynch Display Option for PC
fixed memory leaks related to
pathfinding
ai manager
the bonus factory
UI
fixed an issue with Mouse Hit Detection
improved sorting of 3d info texts
fixed an issue where dead people would block arrows being fired over them
fixed an issue where some spell projectiles would collide with the spell caster and despawn
fixed some issues with Physics capsules
Once testing is complete, we will release these improvements.
We hope you continue to enjoy Sacred 2 Remaster over the weekend and that this first Steam patch further improves your gaming experience.
The Sacred 2 Remaster Team
